mcpConnect.dotPairingPrompt.en: Enter the one-use code from Paperclip’s agent setup to review this connection’s access. Keep the code out of Bot chat. Access is granted only when you approve the named agent below.
mcpConnect.dotPairingPrompt.zh-CN: 输入来自 Paperclip 智能体设置的一次性配对码以查看此连接的访问权限。请勿在机器人对话中发送该配对码。仅当你批准下方指定的智能体后才会授予访问权限。
